Running header and page footer

Source: R/headers.R
bb_running_header.Rd

One line with text on the left and on the right, and a rule: under the text for `bb_running_header()`, above it for `bb_page_footer()`. Both replace `{page}`, `{pages}` and `{<name>}` (from the page's `data`) when the page is exported, so one template serves every page.

Usage

bb_running_header(left, right = NULL, style = header_line_style())

bb_page_footer(left, right = NULL, style = footer_line_style())

Arguments

left, right

Text (either may be `NULL`).

style

A [header_line_style()].

Value

A block.

Examples

bb_running_header("Immunization Profile", "Argentina, 2025")
#> <bb_running_header>
bb_page_footer("PAHO, 2026", "Argentina · {page} / {pages}")
#> <bb_page_footer>
